title: Database pool saturation
content: Compare active connections with configured pool size. Restore the approved pool size only after human approval.

title: Worker memory and OOMKilled
content: Check Kubernetes OOMKilled events and memory trend. Bound caches before raising limits.

title: Search CPU saturation
content: Check traffic, CPU, HPA maximum, and queue latency. Scaling requires approval.

title: Upstream timeout
content: Compare client timeout with upstream latency and recent configuration changes.

title: Backward incompatible schema deployment
content: Identify new required fields and test old records before an approval-gated rollback.

title: TLS certificate expiry
content: Confirm endpoint and certificate expiry. Certificate replacement requires platform approval.

title: Ephemeral storage exhaustion
content: Confirm volume usage and no-space errors. Cleanup or resizing requires approval.

title: Message queue backlog
content: Compare arrival and consumer rates, lag, and replica changes.

title: Internal DNS resolution failure
content: Confirm NXDOMAIN and compare hostname configuration with the service catalog.

title: Insufficient telemetry
content: Return inconclusive when available evidence does not distinguish plausible causes.
